idea-plugin.name: Elasticsearch Client
idea-plugin.description:
Connect to Elasticsearch or OpenSearch clusters from IntelliJ IDEA.

  • Multiple connections with Basic, API key and Bearer authentication
  • Browse indices, aliases, data streams and nodes
  • Cluster health and connection diagnostics

Open source plugin built with the IntelliJ Platform SDK.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.3.0

  • Full context menu for indices: data browser, REST console, info, stats, create, import, copy, aliases, refresh, flush, force merge, mapping, close, delete.
  • Context menu for aliases: data browser, REST console, alias info, delete alias.
  • Read-only data browser with filter, pagination and document viewer.
  • Manage aliases dialog for a single index.

0.2.0

  • REST console with method, path, headers, body and formatted JSON response.
  • Tree categories: Consoles, Requests (history) and Queries.
  • Save consoles, save query bodies, browse/clear request history.
  • Open an index or alias in the console from the context menu.

0.1.2

  • Fixed "Test Connection" staying at "Connecting..." because the modal dialog blocked the UI callback.

0.1.1

  • Tool window id renamed to "Elasticsearch Client" to avoid a conflict with other Elasticsearch plugins.
